title: Bryan Johnson's simplified 2026 morning routine: 4h46m, 5 am wake, 90 min exercise
summary: Bryan walks through his current morning routine, which his team stripped down after scrutinizing every step. It covers 8:30 pm bedtime, light and breath work, a pre-workout stack, 90 min of exercise, daily sauna, red/NIR light, hair and skin care, and a plant-based breakfast. He stresses starting small rather than copying him.

principles.text: Sleep is the top priority; the day starts the night before with an 8:30 pm bedtime.
principles.quote: Every day starts the night before. Sleep is my #1 life priority because high-quality rest makes hard things easy and impossible things doable.

principles.text: Audit every routine step and cut what doesn't earn its place; simplify over time.
principles.quote: We scrutinized every step to determine whether or not it belonged in the routine.

principles.text: Use bright 10,000 lux light for 6 min when waking before sunrise to support circadian rhythm.
principles.quote: Since I wake up before sunrise, I use a 10,000 lux light for 6 min to simulate natural morning light. This helps to support my circadian rhythm (body clock).

principles.text: Exercise 90 min daily, mixing cardio, strength, balance/stretching and HIIT twice a week.
principles.quote: I exercise for 90 min. My workout is a mixture of:

principles.text: Daily 20 min sauna at 200°F, with protections like cooling the face and neck and a wool hat.
Start small rather than copying his routine; let small improvements compound.
principles.quote: If you're struggling, start small. A short walk. 5 min of meditation. 1 better meal. Then let the improvements compound.
